entities.name: Charles de Beauvau, 4th Prince of Beauvau and Craon

entities.summary: Charles Just François-Victurnien de Beauvau-Craon, 4th Prince of Beauvau was a 19th-century French senator and army officer. Though also Prince of Craon he was better known as the Prince of Beauvau.
